name: zalom-skills
description: Agent skills written by Zlatko Alomerovic.

plugins.name: ruby-testing
plugins.description: Writes and refactors Ruby and Rails tests in the project's own framework, Minitest or RSpec, with its fixtures or factories and its mocking library.

plugins.name: ruby-quality-checking
plugins.description: Checks a Ruby or Rails change on the changed code only: lint in the project's style guide, green tests, patch coverage, mutation score, and CRAP scores.

plugins.name: writing-style
plugins.description: Keeps AI-written prose, docs, commit messages, and replies in one style: the Google developer documentation style guide plus optional personal overrides.

plugins.name: skill-creating
plugins.description: Author or revise an Agent Skill, a subagent or agent role file, or a lifecycle hook with progressive disclosure.

plugins.name: skill-evaluating
plugins.description: Evaluate skills for correctness, convention compliance, and progressive disclosure.
